title: Multi-Center circRNA Diagnostic Model for Gastric Cancer Detection
author: Gu, Ma, et al.
materials: To ensure RNA stability and minimize pre-analytical variability, a standardized protocol was implemented across all centers. Peripheral blood was collected in serum separation tubes, allowed to clot at room temperature for 30–60 min, and centrifuged at 1,600 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. The harvested serum underwent a second centrifugation at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C to remove residual cells and debris before being aliquoted and stored at −80 °C. Samples with visible hemolysis, lipemia, or icterus were excluded. All biomarker analyses (circRNAs and conventional tumor markers) for a given individual were performed on the same serum aliquot. RNA was extracted from 250 µL of serum using the Serum Total RNA Extraction Kit (BioTeke Corporation). RNA concentration and purity (A260/A280) were measured, and integrity was verified by agarose gel electrophoresis. RT-qPCR analysis was performed using the Applied Biosystems™ 7500 Real-Time PCR System (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Massachusetts, USA), with amplification of a 20 µL reaction using Taq Pro Universal SYBR qPCR Master Mix. The reference gene used was 18S rRNA. Table 1 lists the specific primers for circRNAs (Sangon Biotech, Shanghai, China).

steps.title: Collect and clot blood
steps.instruction: Collect peripheral blood into serum separation tubes and let it clot at room temperature for 30–60 min.

substeps.instruction: Collect peripheral blood in serum separation tubes.
Allow the blood to clot at room temperature for 30–60 min.

steps.title: First serum centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the clotted blood at 1,600 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,600 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Second serum centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant and centrifuge again at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C to remove residual cells and debris.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Aliquot and store serum
steps.instruction: Aliquot the cleared serum into tubes and store them at –80 °C.

steps.title: Exclude compromised serum samples
steps.instruction: Visually inspect each serum sample and discard any that show hemolysis, lipemia, or icterus.

substeps.instruction: Check for visible hemolysis, lipemia, or icterus.
Exclude any samples with these abnormalities.

steps.title: Extract RNA from serum
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from 250 µL of serum using the Serum Total RNA Extraction Kit (BioTeke Corporation) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Perform RNA extraction with the Serum Total RNA Extraction Kit (BioTeke).

steps.title: Assess RNA quantity and quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and purity (A260/A280) and verify integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Run an agarose gel to assess RNA integrity.

steps.title: Perform RT‑qPCR for circRNAs
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µL RT‑qPCR reaction using Taq Pro Universal SYBR qPCR Master Mix on an Applied Biosystems™ 7500 Real‑Time PCR System, include specific circRNA primers (Table 1) and 18S rRNA as the reference gene.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL reaction with Taq Pro Universal SYBR Master Mix.
Add circRNA‑specific primers (as listed in Table 1).
Include 18S rRNA primers as the reference gene.
Run the reaction on the Applied Biosystems 7500 system.

steps.title: Culture gastric cell lines
steps.instruction: Maintain HGC‑27, AGS, and GES‑1 cells in RPMI 1640 medium (Corning) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (Gibco) and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (HyClone).

substeps.instruction: Obtain HGC‑27, AGS, and GES‑1 cells.
Culture them in RPMI 1640 (Corning) + 10 % FBS (Gibco) + 1 % pen‑streptomycin (HyClone).
